newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower on yen rise, investor sales.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower on yen rise, investor sales.

text.p: Tokyo stocks gave up earlier gains to close sharply lower on Thursday, after buying momentum carried over from the previous day was watered down by the yen's rises against the dollar and sporadic sales by foreign investors, brokers said.
They said Ryutaro Hashimoto's re-election as prime minister by Japan's Lower House of parliament, announced shortly before the market closed, provided little buying incentive.
The key 225-share Nikkei average slipped 220.41 points, or 1.05 percent, to finish at 20,771.11. Its December futures dropped 250 points to 20,850.
